name: Tunday Kebabs
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron strands soaked in milk
instructions: 1. Mix the finely minced meat with raw papaya paste and salt, letting it marinate for at least 2 hours to tenderize. 2. Add ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, and the proprietary spice blend (garam masala, mace, nutmeg, kabab chini). 3. Stir in the roasted gram flour and knead the mixture until it becomes a fine, smooth paste. 4. Mix in the rose water and saffron milk for aroma. 5. Shape the mixture into small, flat patties. 6. Heat ghee on a heavy-bottomed concave tawa and shallow-fry the kebabs on low heat until they develop a deep brown crust and are cooked through.
description: Originating from Lucknow, Tunday Kebabs are a legendary delicacy invented for the toothless Nawab Wajid Ali Shah. The dish is famous for its extreme tenderness and complex spice profile, remaining a cultural icon of Awadhi cuisine.
